 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ANIL KUMAR SINHA  ORAL ORDER 2 14-08-2024 1.
Heard learned Counsel for the petitioner, learned counsel for the informant and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.

2. This application, for grant of anticipatory bail, arises out of Khirimore Police Station Case No. 56 of 2023, dated 02.05.2023, disclosing offences under Sections 409/420/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. The prosecution case, as per the First Information Report, lodged on 02.05.2023, by Assistant Postal Superintendent, Arwal Sub-Division, is that during annual inspection it was detected that co-accused Awadh Bihari Singh, EDDA, employee of the post office, and the petitioner entered the money collected from the villagers/customers Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.48714 of 2024(2)
dt.14-08-2024 in the pass book, but same was not deposited in the post office account.

It has further been stated that the co- accused Awadh Bihari Singh has given in writing that he would deposit the money by 15th September, 2022, but the same has not been deposited despite repeated reminders.
The petitioner, at the relevant time, was the In-charge Post Master and the total amount of embezzlement is Rs. 7,90,700/-.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner, being Branch Manger of the Post Office, was not aware about the conduct of her employee, co-accused Awadh Bihari Singh, inasmuch as from perusal of the First Information Report, it would be evident that the money was collected by Awadh Bihari Singh and not by the petitioner.
He next submits that the petitioner came to know about the defalcation of the amount by the co- accused after registration of First Information Report.

However, a sum of Rs. 8,95,400/- has been deposited by the petitioner without prejudice to her right and contention on 03.05.2024, under acknowledgment, which would be evident from Annexure-P/2.
5.

Regards being had to the submissions made on behalf of Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.48714 of 2024(2) dt.14-08-2024 the parties and taking into consideration the fact that the petitioner is a lady and was Branch Manager of the concerned Post Office and she has already deposited a sum of Rs. 8,95,400/- agasint the embezzeled money, I am inclined to grant the petitioner privilege of anticipatory bail.
6.

7. Let the petitioner, above named, in the event of her arrest or surrender before the Court below within four weeks, be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Ten Thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Judicial Magistrate 1 st Class,
Danapur, in connection with Khirimore Police Station Case No. 56 of 2023, subject to the condition laid down under Section 438 (2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
(Anil Kumar Sinha, J) ashwani/-
